# Near

> Near is a free app for finding events, plans and people around you. Open the map to see what's happening nearby, join local communities, host your own plans, and earn Aura for showing up.

Near is made by WECREO LABS PRIVATE LIMITED (India). Contact: hello@wecreo.in.

## Key facts

- Platforms: Android, free on Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.near.near_radar). The iPhone app is coming soon.
- Map: plans around you appear as pins, showing when they start, how many people are going and how many spots are left.
- Hosting: anyone can host a public or private plan. Pick a category, drop a pin, choose a start time, and set who can join (everyone, or female-only) and how many people.
- Monetization: anyone, including communities, will be able to monetize their events. Paid events are coming soon.
- Safety: everyone on Near is face verified in the app, so nobody can fake a profile or join anonymously. One-tap SOS shares your live location with trusted contacts.
- Aura: a reputation for showing up. Hosting and attending plans moves it up through eight tiers, from Off Radar to Final Boss; ghosting plans can bring it down.
- Communities: local groups around an interest, neighbourhood or cause (run clubs, book clubs, volunteering crews). Communities and NGOs can request a profile at hello@wecreo.in.
- Age: Near is for people aged 18 and over.
